name: WallCue
author: SD無 (neon28)
description: Wall warnings, a Wall Hits counter and a fixed-position collision icon. HUD positioning and switches are integrated into Counters+. Beat Saber PC 1.40.8 Solo/Party prototype.

CountersPlus.CustomCounter.Name: Wall Hits
CountersPlus.CustomCounter.Description: Unique collided walls. Count turns red for 0.5 seconds after each increase.

CountersPlus.CustomCounter.Name: Wall Hit Icon
CountersPlus.CustomCounter.Description: Fixed collision icon: 0.1s fade in, 0.3s hold, 0.1s fade out.
